caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a decorative architectural fragment or carving, shown against a plain, off-white background. The object is predominantly yellow with subtle shading in brown and ochre, suggesting depth and curvature. It has a detailed, ornate design consisting of swirling, curved acanthus leaf patterns and ridged surface textures. At the center of the design, near the bottom left, there is a circular motif containing a small metallic gray star. The shadows and highlights are carefully rendered, giving the object a three-dimensional appearance, and the edges of the fragment appear slightly worn or chipped, revealing some darker brown material underneath the yellow surface. There are no additional objects or textures present in the composition aside from the single decorative fragment.
title: Ship's Billethead from Richard S. Leaming
